title: ComfyUI H3 context fingerprint domain assignment
description: Deterministic, content-free record assigning every inventoried fingerprint consumer and every declared identity site to exactly one versioned domain. It records; it recomputes no existing fingerprint and migrates no accepted identity.

kind.description: An inventoried contract, or a named place in the code whose identity is not a property of any one contract.

domain.description: semantic is the only domain a runtime may consume as an execution, cache or receipt identity.

rule.description: The named rule that made this assignment. Every assignment is made by a rule with a stated criterion; nothing defaults into a domain.

cross_language_partner.description: The counterpart runtime this identity must agree with. Absent records the commoner and more important fact: there is no partner, and the identity must never be compared against one.
